_comment: Homepage transfer news banner — hand-edited, never touched by scripts/update_data.py. Set "enabled" to false to hide the banner without deleting this file. "heading" is the small label shown before the list. Each transfer needs "player" (must match a name in player_profiles.json exactly) and "to" (the destination team, exactly as used elsewhere — see src/data/team-colors.json for team names on record). "from" is optional: without it, the previous team is looked up automatically from player_profiles.json's team_history (falling back to current_team) — but that only works once the Sheet has a week recorded under the new team. Until then, set "from" explicitly, as done below for all four (the season 3 move hasn't been entered in the Sheet yet at time of writing). Safe to remove a player's "from" once their move shows up in team_history after a regen — an entry auto-resolving to the same from/to team is dropped rather than shown as a no-op.
